description: Manage browser tabs and the extension-managed tab group. list/create/close/focus tabs. name puts the tab into a Real Browser MCP tab group and sets the group title (emoji in the title is shown as the group icon). ungroup removes the tab from its group.

action.description: Tab action. name creates or updates the managed tab group title.

color.description: Tab group color for name. Random if omitted when creating a new group.

tabId.description: Tab ID for close/focus/name/ungroup. Defaults to the active tab for name/ungroup.

title.description: Group title for name. Emoji is allowed and Chrome shows it as the group icon.

name: browser_tabs
